MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing this day.
Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
Michele Trausch, Esq. for Plaintiffs: Northern Trust Bank of California, N.A., and Gloria Craib as Co-Trustees.
Plaintiff's witness: Michael Novak, was sworn and examined.
After hearing the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendants: Kristen Nelson and Barbara Nelson dba Zendo Urban Retreat, an Aveda Concept as follows:
Damages $151,014.24
Prejudgment Interest $8,962.55
Attorney's Fees $5,558.00
Costs $392.50 for a total of $165,927.29
Judgment signed in open court.
